floor_area_ratio.reason: The public site package marks floor_area_ratio as missing; concept footprints do not supply floor area.
floor_area_ratio.needed_from: approved regulatory planning conditions or official design brief attachments

building_height_m.reason: The public site package marks building_height_m as missing; no height is inferred from OSM or concept footprints.
building_height_m.needed_from: approved height controls, aviation/landscape/heritage constraints if applicable

building_density.reason: The public site package marks the statutory building-density control as missing; concept-module density is not substituted.

statutory_green_ratio.reason: The public site package marks the statutory green ratio as missing; green_ratio above is only a recomputed design-proposal ratio.
statutory_green_ratio.needed_from: approved regulatory planning conditions or local green-space standards

setback_m.reason: The public site package marks setbacks as missing; no road-redline or fire-control inference is made.
setback_m.needed_from: road redline, building control line, fire and municipal constraints

affected_household_count.reason: OSM interface leads cannot establish households, occupancy, tenure, vulnerability, or causation.
affected_household_count.needed_from: field survey, consented/cleared household data, official address/building data, and a professionally confirmed impact method

mitigation_budget_cny.reason: No verified action quantities, unit costs, compensation rules, funding commitment, or responsible-party agreement is available.
mitigation_budget_cny.needed_from: verified mitigation ledger, reviewed unit rates, affected-party process, funding agreement, and human approval
